answer.answer: I don't have reliable figures for Law et al. 2014's year-by-year concentrations to compute a first-third vs last-third ratio, and sampling locations/effort varied substantially across 2001-2012 within that dataset. Without that breakdown, no factor can be given, and any apparent change couldn't cleanly indicate a true rise in Pacific plastic versus a sampling artifact.
